items.title: Yintoni iBarcode? Intsingiselo, Indlela Esebenza Ngayo, Neentlobo Zayo
items.desc: IBarcode ikho phantse kuzo zonke iimveliso enizithengayo. Yazini indlela esebenza ngayo, imbali yayo emfutshane, kunye neentlobo zebarcode ezisetyenziswa kakhulu.

items.title: Yintoni iQR Code kwaye Isebenza Njani?
items.desc: IQR Code ingagcina ikhonkco, umbhalo, kwanedatha yeWiFi, kwaye isafundeka nokuba inxalenye yayo yonakele. Nantsi indlela esebenza ngayo kunye neenzuzo zayo.

items.title: Indlela Yokwenza iQR Code Simahla Ngamanyathelo ama-3
items.desc: Isikhokelo esisebenzayo sokwenza iQR Code yekhonkco, iWiFi, uqhagamshelwano, okanye i-WhatsApp ngaphandle kwe-app nangaphandle kokubhalisa, kunye neengcebiso zokuyenza ilula ukuskena.

items.title: Umahluko phakathi kweBarcode ye-1D neye-2D: Yeyiphi Eniyidingayo?
items.desc: IBarcode yemigca neQR Code zombini ziibarcode, kodwa ukusetyenziswa kwazo kwahlukile. Thelekisani umthamo, indlela yokuskena, kunye nemizekelo yokusetyenziswa kwazo.

items.title: Indlela Yokufumana iBarcode Yemveliso ye-EAN-13 Kumashishini Amancinci
items.desc: Ningathanda ukuba iimveliso zenu zingene kwiivenkile ezincinci okanye ezinkulu? Fundani intsingiselo yamanani e-EAN-13, indlela yokubhalisa inombolo esemthethweni kwi-GS1 Indonesia, kunye nendlela yokuyishicilela.

items.title: Indlela Yokwenza iQR Code yeWiFi Ukuze Iindwendwe Zingachwethezi Iphasiwedi
items.desc: Iindwendwe zidinga nje ukuskena iQR Code ukuze zidibane neWiFi. Ilungele iikhefi, iiofisi, iindawo zokuhlala, namakhaya. Nantsi indlela yokuyenza nokuyibeka.

items.title: Ubukhulu Nesisombululo Esifanelekileyo SeBarcode Yokushicilela
items.desc: IBarcode encinci kakhulu okanye efiphele kunzima ukuyiskena. Fundani ubukhulu obuncinane, umthetho womgama wokuskena, kunye nesisombululo somfanekiso esikhuselekileyo sokushicilela.

items.title: Izizathu ezi-7 zokuba iBarcode Ingaskeneki Kunye Nendlela Yokuzisombulula
items.desc: IBarcode okanye iQR Code ayiskeneki? Jongani izizathu ezisixhenxe ezenzeka rhoqo, ukusuka kumahluko wemibala ukuya kubukhulu, kunye nendlela yokuzilungisa.

items.title: IQR Code Yemenyu Yerestyu: Isikhokelo Esipheleleyo
items.desc: Imenyu yedijithali ngeQR Code yenza izinto zibe lula kubathengi kwaye yonga iindleko zokushicilela. Nantsi indlela yokuyenza, ukulungiselela imenyu, nokuyibeka etafileni.

items.title: Uyilo LweQR Code Oluyilayo Olusaskenekayo
items.desc: IQR Code ingenziwa ibe nemilo yentliziyo, yesangqa, okanye inikwe isakhelo nemibala. Fundani imithetho yokugcina uyilo lunomtsalane kwaye lulula ukuskena.
